description: This file implements event handling logic for the Wesnoth game, including event dispatching, focus management, and input processing.

classes.name: resize_lock
classes.description: A RAII class that manages the disallow_resize counter to prevent window resizing during critical sections.

classes.name: context
classes.description: Represents a collection of event handlers and manages focus among them.

methods.name: resize_lock
methods.description: Constructor that increments disallow_resize; destructor that decrements it.

methods.name: context::add_handler
methods.description: Adds a handler to the context.

methods.name: context::delete_handler_index
methods.description: Removes a handler at a specific index from the context.

methods.name: context::remove_handler
methods.description: Removes a handler from the context, updating focus accordingly.

methods.name: context::cycle_focus
methods.description: Cycles focus to the next handler requiring event focus.

methods.name: context::set_focus
methods.description: Sets focus to a specific handler if it requires event focus.

methods.name: event_context::event_context
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new event context stack if specified.

methods.name: event_context::~event_context
methods.description: Destructor that pops the event context stack if created.

methods.name: handler::handler
methods.description: Constructor that enables Unicode input, key repeat, and registers the handler.

methods.name: handler::~handler
methods.description: Destructor that unregisters the handler and restores Unicode state.
